target_statement: Every lossy message an agent writes to its future self (a compaction summary) or to another agent (a handoff brief, a return summary) is a decision. At each such boundary two numbers decide whether learning can help: SIGNAL C(h) = Var over resampled messages of downstream success, which is all an outcome-reward policy gradient can see; and HEADROOM H(h) = success when continuing with the full context minus mean success after the message, which is what any compactor could recover. Claim: published RL gains on compaction land in the high-C/high-H regime; low-C/high-H regimes are signal-starved and move only with judge-corrected SFT or a stronger external compressor; low-H regimes should not be trained at all. The map, measured on a base model before training, is a recipe-selection diagnostic.

method.estimators: at node h: m summaries x n continuations each, plus n_full full-context continuations; V-hat = success fraction; C-hat = sample variance of V-hat across summaries minus mean V-hat(1-V-hat)/(n-1); H-hat = V-hat_full - mean V-hat
method.design: 50 SWE-bench Verified or Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks; forced compaction at 32K on a 256K-window open model (Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B as AutoCompact, or 8-14B); m=8, n=4, n_full=8; ~3,750 episode-equivalents; 60-120 H100-hours; 1-2 weeks
method.validation: base vs RL compactor checkpoints (ContextPilot, AutoCompact if released; else a 100-step GRPO run on Qwen3-8B, 50-100 H100-hours): per-regime gains should concentrate in high-C/high-H; generalization across nodes means the claim is at distribution/regime level, per-node correlation is secondary
method.second_site: handoff: C_brief = Var over briefs of sub-agent-plus-continuation success; U = mean over briefs of sub-agent execution variance (luck floor); return summary: same C/H with the full transcript as the full-context arm
